def solve(facts):
    jobs=facts['jobs']
    n=len(jobs)
    ids=[j['id'] for j in jobs]
    idx={x:i for i,x in enumerate(ids)}
    pred=[sum(1<<idx[p] for p in j['predecessors']) for j in jobs]
    best=None
    def search(mask,t,order,starts,wt):
        nonlocal best
        if len(order)==n:
            seq=tuple(ids[i] for i in order)
            key=(wt,t,seq)
            if best is None or key<best[0]: best=(key,order[:],starts[:])
            return
        for i,j in enumerate(jobs):
            bit=1<<i
            if mask&bit or pred[i]&mask != pred[i]: continue
            s=max(t,j['release'])
            c=s+j['duration']
            nw=wt+j['weight']*max(0,c-j['due'])
            if best is not None and nw>best[0][0]: continue
            search(mask|bit,c,order+[i],starts+[s],nw)
    search(0,0,[],[],0)
    _,order,starts=best
    return {'order':[ids[i] for i in order],'starts':starts,'finish':best[0][1],'weighted_tardiness':best[0][0]}

def check(answer,facts):
    jobs=facts['jobs']; n=len(jobs); ids=[j['id'] for j in jobs]
    idx={x:i for i,x in enumerate(ids)}
    pred=[sum(1<<idx[p] for p in j['predecessors']) for j in jobs]
    order_ids=answer['order']
    if len(order_ids)!=n or len(set(order_ids))!=n or set(order_ids)!=set(ids): return False
    order=[idx[x] for x in order_ids]; starts=answer['starts']
    if len(starts)!=n: return False
    t=0; wt=0
    for k,i in enumerate(order):
        if pred[i] & sum(1<<z for z in order[:k]) != pred[i]: return False
        s=max(t,jobs[i]['release'])
        if starts[k]!=s: return False
        t=s+jobs[i]['duration']; wt+=jobs[i]['weight']*max(0,t-jobs[i]['due'])
    if answer['finish']!=t or answer['weighted_tardiness']!=wt: return False
    # Independently enumerate feasible schedules to verify lexicographic optimum.
    best=None
    def visit(mask,time,seq,cost):
        nonlocal best
        if mask==(1<<n)-1:
            key=(cost,time,tuple(ids[i] for i in seq))
            if best is None or key<best: best=key
            return
        for i in range(n):
            bit=1<<i
            if mask&bit or pred[i]&mask != pred[i]: continue
            c=max(time,jobs[i]['release'])+jobs[i]['duration']
            nc=cost+jobs[i]['weight']*max(0,c-jobs[i]['due'])
            visit(mask|bit,c,seq+[i],nc)
    visit(0,0,[],0)
    return (wt,t,tuple(order_ids))==best
